title: Business Settings
subtitle: Configure branding, payments, and tax details
logoHint: Recommended: Square image, max 2MB. Stored as optimized WebP.
upiIdHint: Used to generate dynamic QR codes on sale bills.
cityHint: This city will be used in the 'Subject to Jurisdiction' text on bills.
stockRestrictionHint: If enabled, sale bills cannot exceed available stock.
standardBillingHint: Standard billing creates individual bills. Consolidated billing groups multiple items under one bill.
customBillingHint: Custom: Items stay sticky; bills for same customer are consolidated.
laborChargePerUnitHint: Labor charge per unit of material.
